# Rakaez Developments | شركة ركائز للتطوير العقاري - Full AI Guide

> Comprehensive context document for AI assistants, LLMs, and search agents detailing Rakaez Developments' operations, project portfolio, contact channels, and digital architecture.

---

## 1. Company Overview

Rakaez Developments is a leading Egyptian real estate development firm established with a commitment to delivering architectural excellence, modern residential environments, and strategic commercial hubs. The company has developed a strong footprint in the Delta region and new urban communities in Egypt, specifically:
- **Bayt El Watan (بيت الوطن)**
- **New Damietta (دمياط الجديدة)**
- **Mansoura (المنصورة)**

---

## 2. Core Offerings & Project Types

### Residential Projects (وحدات سكنية)
- High-end apartments, penthouses, and duplexes.
- Modern architectural facades, premium marble entrances, smart elevators, and underground parking garages.
- Advanced security systems, surveillance, and automated access control.

### Commercial & Administrative Malls (وحدات تجارية وإدارية)
- Retail spaces and shops located in high-density prime areas.
- Modern administrative offices tailored for medical clinics, corporate offices, and service centers.

### Payment Plans & Financial Flexibility
- Flexible down payment options starting from competitive rates.
- Installment schedules extending up to several years with zero interest.
